name: Solenne Atelier AutoDry Stormweave Rain Cape
description: A floor-sweeping rain cape in ivory-white smart-fabric that sheds water on contact and returns to a pressed, dry state within forty seconds via embedded micro-thermal filaments activated by body heat. Cut with a high Mandarin-Andean collar and a rear pleat that opens cleanly for wings or dorsal geneware. Worn at Spire level as a casual weather layer — the fact that it costs more than a Circuit worker's monthly wage is entirely the point.
functionality: Self-drying smart-fabric cape with body-heat-activated micro-thermal reset; rear pleat accommodates wing and dorsal geneware.
what_it_says: The rain doesn't touch this person — not really, not in any way that matters.
story_hooks: A cape matching this description was left folded on a Shelf bench in Tier 1 last winter — no identification, no surveillance footage of who left it.
The AutoDry filament network can theoretically be reprogrammed; a Shelf hacker claims to have a method that turns it into a passive surveillance mesh.

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic floor-length cape with commanding presence, ivory-white fabric catching light like a second skin. High Mandarin-Andean collar frames the neck with structured elegance. Rear pleat splits cleanly down the center, designed to accommodate augmented wings or dorsal modifications without constraint. The silhouette reads as both ethereal and engineered—draped yet precise.
physical_description.fit: Gracefully oversized and floor-sweeping, with a relaxed drape from the shoulders that maintains architectural precision through the torso. The rear pleat allows full freedom of movement and augmentation access. Collar sits snug against the neck, creating a sharp contrast to the flowing lower garment.
physical_description.primary_material: Smart-fabric composite: synthetic hydrophobic weave with embedded micro-thermal filaments. Responds actively to moisture and body heat. Appears as premium tech-treated material with subtle sheen.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and almost liquid in appearance, with barely perceptible grid pattern from embedded heating elements visible only in direct light. Feels gossamer-light yet substantial. No visible seams—construction appears seamless.
physical_description.color_scheme: Ivory-white as primary, with faint iridescent sheen that shifts subtly in different lighting. No patterns or logos visible—the material itself is the statement.
physical_description.closures: None—cape drapes from shoulders freely. Mandarin collar features discreet magnetic micro-snaps (nearly invisible) for optional securing.
distinctive_features: Embedded micro-thermal filaments activated by body heat
Rear pleat engineered for augmented wings or dorsal geneware
Seamless construction with no visible stitching
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—prohibitively expensive, worn as status display by corporate elite and augmented gentry
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer signals: extreme wealth, sophisticated taste, likely augmented (the rear pleat accommodation is a tell), comfort with cutting-edge biotech integration, Spire-level access and lifestyle
physical_description.condition_typical: Always appears pressed and pristine due to self-maintaining smart-fabric. Never wrinkled, never damp. Impeccable even after heavy use.

image_prompt: A statuesque model with subtle chrome augmentation at the temples wears a floor-length ivory-white smart-fabric cape with high Mandarin-Andean collar, standing in a rain-soaked Spire plaza at dusk. Water beads and rolls off the fabric in perfect spheres. Dramatic upward lighting catches the barely-visible micro-thermal grid pattern. The rear pleat is visible, splitting cleanly—suggesting space for dorsal geneware. Moody neo-noir urban aesthetic, neon signage reflecting off wet pavement behind her. The cape's edges catch ambient light like liquid metal. Shot from a low angle emphasizing the dramatic floor-sweep and architectural collar.
